● GEO · generative engine optimisation

An AI answer is assembled from a few pages. That is where GEO works.

01

The question

A buyer asks in plain words. The engine breaks it into several sub-queries.

02

The sources

It pulls a small set of pages it trusts: your site, round-ups, directories, forums.

03

The answer

It names three to five options and quotes what those pages say about each.

04

The gap

Thin pages, or absence from the pages it cites, and you are not named — on any engine.
